title: ICAI Invites Feedback on CA Inter & Foundation Sept 2026 Question Papers
content:
# ICAI Invites Feedback on CA Inter & Foundation Sept 2026 Question Papers

Ek important update hai. The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne CA Intermediate aur Foundation September 2026 examinations ke question papers par candidates se observations invite kiye hain.

Here are the key details:

*   **What:** Candidates apne observations ya discrepancies regarding the question papers ICAI ko submit kar sakte hain.
*   **Why:** This initiative allows the Institute to consider candidate feedback for examination improvements.
*   **Notice Date:** The official notice was issued on September 1, 2026.
*   **Submission Methods:** Feedback can be sent via email to `examfeedback[at]icai[dot]in` or through a letter sent by Speed Post.
*   **Postal Address:** The Joint Secretary (Exams), The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, ICAI Bhawan, Indraprastha Marg, New Delhi – 110 002.
*   **Deadline:** Observations must reach ICAI latest by September 17, 2026.
*   **Mandatory Information:** For feedback to be considered, candidates must include their Name, Registration number, Roll number, Email-id, and Mobile number.
